req.title: List cookies
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /cookies with a JSON body listing all cookies present on the request.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return a JSON body listing all cookies present on the request when a GET request is made to the /cookies endpoint. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct behavior, a negative test to handle unexpected input, and a boundary test to check edge cases.

tests.name: test_list_cookies_positive
preconditions: The client has set cookies in the request.
actions: Send a GET request to /cookies with cookies set.
expected: HTTP 200 response with a JSON body listing all cookies.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'test_cookie=test_value'})
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json == {'cookies': {'test_cookie': 'test_value'}}

tests.name: test_list_cookies_negative
preconditions: The client sends a malformed request.
actions: Send a GET request to /cookies with an invalid method.
expected: HTTP 405 response indicating method not allowed.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.post('/cookies')
assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: test_list_cookies_boundary
preconditions: The client has set a large number of cookies in the request.
actions: Send a GET request to /cookies with a large number of cookies.
expected: HTTP 200 response with a JSON body listing all cookies.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
cookies = {f'cookie{i}': f'value{i}' for i in range(100)}
cookie_header = '; '.join([f'{k}={v}' for k, v in cookies.items()])
response = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': cookie_header})
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json == {'cookies': cookies}
